about.intro: I **believe** the most **interesting work** happens when *curiosity* meets *practical execution*.
about.description: What starts as **curiosity** often becomes something worth building. I've explored *software development*, *financial markets*, and *digital advertising* through hands-on work, research, and experimentation.
about.full:
Hi, I'm **Mohammed Faiz Alam**. I'm a self-driven developer, agency founder, and swing trader with an interest in understanding how things work and putting ideas into practice.

I primarily work with *React*, *Next.js*, *TypeScript*, *JavaScript*, *Node.js*, and *Python*, building web applications and exploring different areas of software engineering. I also work with *C* and *MySQL*.

Alongside development, I run **AgencyGrow**, an advertising agency managing full-funnel *Google and Meta ad campaigns*, with a focus on budget allocation, conversion tracking, and campaign optimisation.

I'm also interested in **swing trading**, studying price action, *Volume Profile*, POC, VAH, VAL, high and low volume nodes, and liquidity zones to identify potential market opportunities.

I prefer learning through **hands-on work, experimentation, and independent research**. I'm currently pursuing my **B.Tech in Computer Engineering at Shree L.R. Tiwari College of Engineering**.

projects.title: BB84 Quantum
projects.description:
An interactive **BB84 Quantum Key Distribution** simulator showing how quantum physics secures key exchange and catches eavesdroppers. Users step through state preparation, basis selection, key sifting, and *One-Time Pad* encryption in real time.

Built with a *React* and *TypeScript* frontend and a *Python FastAPI* engine, it calculates **Quantum Bit Error Rate (QBER)** to flag interception attempts the moment a third party measures the channel.

projects.title: Nuvora
projects.description:
Nuvora is the digital storefront and client acquisition platform for my creative and advertising startup. Designed to turn cold traffic into booked discovery calls, it pairs bold editorial typography with interactive case-study storytelling and clear service positioning.

Engineered with *Next.js*, *React*, and *TypeScript*, the interface uses *Framer Motion*, *GSAP*, and *Locomotive Scroll* for fluid scroll choreography while keeping layout shifts zero and page loads fast across devices.

projects.title: RL Trading Env
projects.description:
RL Trading Env is a full reinforcement learning workbench for training and evaluating autonomous trading agents against historical and synthetic *OHLCV* market data. Instead of optimizing for raw return alone, its custom *Gymnasium* environment scores agents with a risk-aware reward function that penalizes deep drawdowns and erratic sizing.

The *Python* and *FastAPI* backend runs **Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)** episodes and streams execution logs to a *React* and *TypeScript* dashboard featuring live price charts, equity curves, drawdown metrics, and trade-by-trade blotters.

projects.title: Google Ads
projects.description:
Managed Google Ads campaigns for a **UK-based roofing business**, focused on turning search intent into qualified enquiries. Campaigns were structured around high-intent roofing keywords, location targeting, and carefully managed budgets to reach customers actively looking for roofing services.

Performance was monitored through **conversion tracking, cost per lead (CPL), click-through rate (CTR), conversion rate, and total ad spend**. Continuous keyword refinement, search term analysis, and bid optimisation helped improve campaign efficiency and make every advertising pound count.

projects.title: Audience Analytics
projects.description:
Analysed website traffic and audience behaviour over a 28-day period, recording **89K active users** and **80K new users**. The property generated **1.3M events**, providing a broader view of how visitors interacted with the website.

Tracked key performance indicators including page views, active users, and bounce rates to understand traffic distribution, identify high-performing pages, and evaluate overall audience engagement.

projects.title: User Engagement
projects.description:
Evaluated audience activity across a 28-day period, recording **32K active users** and **15K new users**, with an average engagement time of **6 minutes 44 seconds** per active user.

Monitored daily traffic trends, geographic distribution, and real-time activity to understand how users interacted with the platform. These insights helped build a clearer picture of audience behaviour, acquisition patterns, and engagement quality.
